# Pilot results and next decision

Status: not run. All 20 clips are development material after audit inspection.

## Sample and acquisition

Candidate attempts, successful media retrievals, replacements, creators/source groups, categories, permission status, actual durations, and 12/8 partition compliance.

## Versions and costs

Extraction, baseline, teacher, prompts, schema, frame policy, billed tokens, cash payments, used/unused credits, review time, and remaining total budget.

## Target review

Acceptance/edit/reject counts, major rewrite proportion, review minutes, second-reviewer agreement where available, and example corrections.

## Challenge outcomes

For each of the eight cases: implemented control, attempted input, observed output, pass/fail/not run, and remediation.

## Error analysis

Acquisition versus extraction versus synthesis versus validation/rendering. Include at least three addressable synthesis examples if recommending training.

## Decision

Go, revise, or stop. Explain which pilot gates were met and which were not. Record changes to the protocol before the later frozen study.

## Next milestone

Data collection target, owners, dependencies, remaining budget, and explicit release-review requirements.
